scripts.kill: powershell -NoProfile -Command "taskkill /f /im Ragnarok-launcher.exe /t 2>$null; taskkill /f /im msedgewebview2.exe /t 2>$null; Start-Sleep 2; $pids=(netstat -ano | Select-String ':5173 ' | ForEach-Object {($_ -split '\s+')[-1]} | Where-Object {$_ -match '^[0-9]+$' -and [int]$_ -gt 0} | Sort-Object -Unique); foreach($p in $pids){taskkill /f /pid $p 2>$null}; Write-Host 'Port 5173 cleared'"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run kill && npm run tauri dev
